items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I have been fortunate enough to have met Seminole

ctx.x: Yes. But I wasn't quite sure whether I played drums or piano because sometimes you'd catch me, I would be playing saxophone. Sometimes I'd be singing. Some places I'd be dancing. Some places I'd get on the show, I'd be doing everything because I remember in 1930 I joined a show and there were 3 pianists. A piano player by the name of Troy and Floyd; Washington, was his last name. That's all I knew because they only called him Washington because in those days they only called, Washington.
